description: Abstract class ByteBuffer providing methods for reading and writing bytes, integers, and shorts with support for buffer operations like get, put, clear, and size management.

classes.name: ByteBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class defining a byte buffer with methods for reading and writing bytes, integers, and shorts, including buffer state checks and exception handling.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Abstract method to get the buffer's capacity.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current data length in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the next byte from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[] buf)
methods.description: Fills the provided byte array with data from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[] buf, int off, int len)
methods.description: Fills part of the byte array with data from the buffer, starting at offset off for length len.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Abstract method to put a byte into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[] buf)
methods.description: Puts the entire byte array into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[] buf, int off, int len)
methods.description: Puts part of the byte array into the buffer, starting at offset off for length len.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 16-bit short from the buffer.

methods.name: putInt
methods.description: Puts a little-endian 32-bit integer into the buffer.
